_readme: Road/path geometry OpenStreetMap does not carry yet. Visual only, these do not feed the routing graph. Better still, add it to OpenStreetMap directly and it arrives here on the next `npm run fetch`.

_schema.name: street name, optional
_schema.hw: OSM-style highway value: footway | path | cycleway | track | steps | service | residential | tertiary | secondary | primary | unclassified | living_street. Only affects road vs. path styling.
_schema.coords: array of [lat, lon] pairs tracing the line, in order, at least 2 points
